title: The 1871 Act Didn't Do What You Think: A Deep Dive Into the Law
summary: Civics explainer showing the 1871 Organic Act only reorganized DC's local government, debunking the corporation, title-change and bankruptcy myths.

assertions.quote: It reorganized only the District of Columbia's local government.
Courts have repeatedly dismissed these claims as frivolous.
the federal government itself historically has never declared bankruptcy

verdicts.note: The 1871 Act only set up a municipal government for the District, with powers 'not inconsistent with the constitution and laws of the United States'. It replaced no constitution and was itself abolished in 1874.
